Nina (eng-oncall): quick follow-up from the eviction postmortem  we need a short actionable plan for tests + owners. goal: staging canary in 14 days.
Diego (eng-ml): i'll curate a compact regression set (60 prompts) focused on long-prefix reuse and small-burst queries. will include 4 golden prompts for pre-merge. ETA 8 days.
Hannah (eng-platform): i'll add two CI jobs: pre-merge/kv-smoke (fast) and nightly/kv-staging (larger). will wire metrics push to the eval metrics DB. ETA 10 days for smoke + dashboards.
Sven (sre): i'll own the chaos checklist and a 20m drill simulating eviction pressure + node restart. will add rollback criteria. ETA 12 days.
Nina (eng-oncall): can we get an epic for tracking? please include owners + due dates.
ops-bot: Epic EPI-2501 "eviction-safeguards-regression-sprint" created. Subtasks: EPI-2501-1 regression prompts (Diego) due 1767926399, EPI-2501-2 pre-merge smoke + nightly (Hannah) due 1768000000, EPI-2501-3 chaos drill + runbook (Sven) due 1768003600.
Diego (eng-ml): i'll tag the high-visibility prompts with `@prod-guard` and include small scorer that fails only on large semantic drift.
Hannah (eng-platform): sample CI snippet for pre-merge smoke: 
```
name: pre-merge-kv-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/kv_smoke.sh --goldens
```
Sven (sre): please add the postmortem link to all subtasks. add me as backup owner for nightly alerts.
Nina (eng-oncall): summary: owners assigned, epic created, staging canary target 14 days, reconvene in 7 days for status. :thumbsup:
